method: For each ankle, forward coordinate relative to pelvis in body yaw axes, both actual and GMR target. Lag maximizes Pearson correlation reference(t) vs actual(t+lag); positive means robot lags GMR. Search -500..500ms in10ms steps, fixed2s nonoverlapping windows starting at2s and with full lag margin. Windows selected identically using baseline reference p95-p05 excursion>10cm. Retain correlations>=0.6 and interior peaks; report counts, median and IQR. Source/root/nav commands natural, same1s warmup and physical fork. Native policy cadence100Hz for1112601000,50Hz for111586500.
limitations: Motion phase lag estimate, not end-to-end sensor/display latency, nor GMR compute time.
Low-correlation or ambiguous periodic gait can make a single time lag a poor description; inspect per-window values and retained counts.
Two recordings, deterministic offline rollouts, no Quest acceptance.
